literal_meaning: খগ (পাখি) এবং বগা (কীটপতঙ্গ) গোছের লেখাপড়া শেখা
figurative_meaning_en: Devoid of proper or useful education
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার খগাবগা শিক্ষা কোনো কাজে আসে না।
এই খগাবগা জ্ঞান নিয়ে জীবন চালানো যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: His khagabaga education doesn't help in real life.
You can't survive on this useless khagabaga knowledge.
history: The idiom originates from the idea of learning the 'scripts' or 'languages' of birds (khaga) and insects (baga), symbolizing pointless or irrelevant studies in traditional Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom highlights the cultural emphasis on practical education in Bengali society.
